Issue Number: close https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/36284

Problem Summary:

### What is changed and how it works?

Move `index` and `Column` into different file from `histogram.go`, avoid embedding `CMSketch` and `TopN` in order to help us to check nil.

comments: Though we can directly fix this problem by checking CMSKetch, I think a better solution is to move the stats (hist/cmsketch/topn) into a sub package and checking each public function in order to avoid this problem again.
